title: Skills Clinic Episode 101: How to Build, Review & Optimize AI Agent Skills (From Sick to Healthy!)
description:
Is your AI agent skill truly effective, or just an illusion of success? Transitioning a "sick" skill to a robust, "healthy" one involves moving beyond vibe-based evaluations to a structured process using automated tools. It's about more than just a surface fix — it's about delving into the core, where real impact counts.

The Skills Clinic series dismantles and rebuilds AI agent skills for optimal performance. Immersed in the process, you'll explore the intricacies of a structured skill creation, from simple REST API generation to tackling security challenges with SonarCloud. Enhance your prompt engineering and discover the true potential of well-crafted AI agent skills.

What we cover:
• What is a skill in the context of AI agents?
• Why do vibe-evals fail, and what's the better approach?
• How do you generate a REST API Todo app using Claude Code?
• Does SonarCloud expose real security and quality issues? The shocking answer revealed.
• How can you differentiate between lazy-loaded skills and always-loaded rules?
• How to package skills into tiles for reuse and sharing?
